The '''Angor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Myto sector/Legends|Myto sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system was where [[Kyp's Dozen]] [[Battle of the Angor system|battled]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] shortly before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
